g.text: A file is chunked into blocks; only the one changed block re-syncs, not the whole file.
user edits one part of the file
Device B swaps out its old B3 for B3' and reassembles v2 locally -- 4MB moved, not the whole 2GB file.
The block ID is its hash, so identical blocks across files or users are the same stored object -- dedup for free.
